title: yukibana.json

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, https://cloud.yukibana.dev/schema/yukibana/v1.json, for an editor to check the file with. Names the version too, so it must match version.

version.description: The shape of this file: 1. A file in a newer shape needs a newer IDE and CLI, which say so.

kind.description: The build system. Chooses the build output no archive carries and the manifest checks the build makes.

hidden.description: Globs of files the student never receives: removed from the starter, and from the starter's copy of this file. When a teacher assembles a submission they are put back from the teacher's version, like readOnly. A pattern naming a directory covers everything under it; * stays within a path segment, ** crosses segments, ? is one character. [] hides nothing.

assignmentFile.description: The file the IDE opens as the assignment, relative to the project root.

squiggles.description: Error and warning underlines in the editor.

features.description: Which of the IDE's helpers are on.

widgets.description: Which of the IDE's own views show.

containers.description: View containers by id, shown if true and hidden if false; one not named is left as it is. {} leaves them all.

views.description: Views by id, shown if true and hidden if false; one not named is left as it is. {} leaves them all.

layout.description: How the IDE lays out the project's window.

openFiles.description: Files the IDE opens when the project opens, relative to the project root. Paths, not globs.

readOnly.description: Globs of files the student receives but may not change. When a teacher assembles a submission, whatever the student sent under these paths is replaced by the teacher's version, and every change is reported. [] protects nothing.

include.description: Only paths matching one of these globs are submitted, and yukibana.json always. ["**"] submits everything the other rules allow.

exclude.description: Globs never submitted, on top of the history, the IDE's state, node_modules and the kind's build output, which never are.

respectGitignore.description: Whether what the project's .gitignore files ignore is left out of a submission too, as git would leave it out of a commit.

target.description: Where the IDE sends a submission: cloud, the registry, or file, an archive the student saves. The CLI always sends to the registry.

filename.description: What yukibana pack calls the archive it writes. The bytes are always a gzipped tar, whatever the name says.

maxBytes.description: The largest submission this project expects, in bytes. The registry has its own cap above which this cannot go.

submission.description: What a submission from this folder holds, and where the IDE sends it.

liveTypingStats.description: Whether to send live stats about what the student is typing in the IDE.

description: A project's configuration: its build system, what the student's IDE shows, which files the student may not change, what the student never receives, and what a submission holds. Lives at the project root as yukibana.json. Every field is required.
